sources.name: ETHGlobal Events
sources.notes: Official ETHGlobal event calendar. Verify event-specific eligibility, deadlines and prize rules before publishing those details.

sources.name: CTFtime Upcoming Events
sources.notes: Use for discovery. Follow through to organizer pages before treating rules, scope, registration or prize claims as verified.

sources.name: GitHub Search
sources.notes: Use to discover relevant repositories and tools. Verify repository license, recent maintenance, release status and documentation before recommending adoption.

sources.name: USA.gov Active Federal Challenges
sources.notes: Official successor discovery page after Challenge.gov was sunset on March 30, 2026. Verify each challenge's eligibility, deadline, judging criteria and award terms on its official listing/hosting agency page. The stable source ID is retained for compatibility.

sources.name: HackerOne Program Directory
sources.notes: Program discovery only. A program listing is not authorization for arbitrary testing; agents must open and preserve the exact target scope and rules before security work.

sources.name: Code4rena Contests
sources.notes: Track public audit competitions. Verify active contest status, scope, repository/commit, dates and award rules before creating a case.

sources.name: Sherlock Contests
sources.notes: Track public smart-contract audit contests. Preserve exact contest scope/rules before testing.

sources.name: Sherlock Bug Bounties
sources.notes: Track Sherlock-hosted bug-bounty programs. A LIVE listing is only a discovery lead; preserve and verify the exact scope, exclusions, severity rules and submission terms before any testing.

sources.name: arXiv Cryptography Research
sources.notes: Research discovery source. Distinguish preprints from peer-reviewed work and summarize claims conservatively.

sources.name: Algora Open-Source Bounties
sources.notes: Discover GitHub/open-source coding bounties. Before promoting a bounty, verify the underlying issue remains open, reward and acceptance criteria are current, claim competition and merged/landed fixes do not make it obsolete, required technologies are understood, and payout terms are clear.

sources.name: Topcoder Challenges
sources.notes: Track active development, AI, data and related challenges. Verify registration/open status, reward, deadline, submission and acceptance criteria, technology requirements, competition state and any final-fix obligations before promoting a challenge.

sources.name: Upwork Software Development Jobs
sources.notes: Use as a discovery lane for software-development freelance work. Verify each posting remains open, budget and payment terms, client/project legitimacy, technical requirements, deadline, acceptance/delivery expectations and competition before recommending it.

sources.name: Freelancer Software Development Jobs
sources.notes: Use as a discovery lane for programming jobs and contests. Verify each project/contest remains open, budget or prize, payment terms, client legitimacy, technology requirements, deadline, acceptance criteria and existing bid/entry competition before recommending it.

sources.name: Gitcoin Bounty Mechanisms
sources.notes: Official Gitcoin reference for task-based bounty mechanisms, not a guarantee of a current live bounty catalog. Follow any lead to the actual funder/project/platform and verify open status, deliverables, reward, acceptance criteria, competing claims and payment terms before promoting it.

sources.name: Intigriti Public Bug Bounty Programs
sources.notes: Public-program discovery only; public visibility is not blanket authorization. Before testing, preserve the exact program brief and verify in-scope assets, exclusions, prohibited techniques, request/rate limits, safe-harbor terms, severity/reward rules and submission requirements.

sources.name: Bugcrowd Public Engagements
sources.notes: Discover public Bugcrowd engagements. A listing does not authorize activity outside its brief; verify engagement status, exact targets/scope, exclusions, prohibited techniques, rate limits, safe-harbor/disclosure terms, severity/reward rules and submission requirements before any security testing.
